title: Karma Important Fields Standard (Market + Daily + B2B)
title_zh: Karma 重要字段标准版（市场垂类 + 日常刚需 + B2B）
description: Protocol captures ImportantFields during interaction. Buyer and seller submit AES-GCM ciphertext. MATCHED only when buyer_hash == seller_hash == protocol_hash.
description_zh: 交互中由协议抓取并锁定重要字段；双方以加密字符提交；仅当买方、卖方与协议三方 hash 一致时才可封存上链。

source_of_truth.notes: market_vertical: ServiceCategory 1–11. daily_commerce: ride_hailing/hotel_booking/food_delivery/flight_booking (aligns VERIFIER_NODE_API_SPEC serviceType). b2b_digital: b2b_procurement/data_api_billing/api_tool_call. extensions: legal_compliance/custom_service.

canonicalization.json: RFC8785-like: UTF-8, object keys sorted lexicographically, no insignificant whitespace, arrays keep order, numbers as JSON numbers (no leading zeros), datetimes as ISO-8601 UTC with trailing Z, null omitted only if field optional and unset
canonicalization.match_rule: buyer.fields_hash == seller.fields_hash → MATCHED; else COUNTERED with field-level diff

common_fields.description: Required for every scene unless marked optional.

required.market_note: 双方必须一致；超时进入争议/违约路径

required.description_zh: 任务要求（自然语言 + 可核验要点）
验收标准列表；完成后只按这些条款验
成交金额（十进制字符串，避免浮点误差）

optional.description_zh: 约定开始/履约起始时间
地点；纯数字交付可省略或 place=on_chain/digital

address_hash.description: SHA-256 of full address if PII must not be plaintext

optional.description_zh: 买方 agent id（双方提交时必须相同）
卖方 agent id（双方提交时必须相同）
可交付物清单（名称或内容哈希）
完成后证据包必须覆盖的字段名
场景专属字段（见各 scene.required_scene_fields）

extensions.note_zh: 不在 11 个首发市场场景内，但链上枚举已有；字段模板接近 consulting_advisory，另加强管辖与文件清单。
必须仍提交 common_fields；scene 下用自由键，但 acceptance_criteria 与 required_proof_fields 不得为空。

lifecycle.protocol_capture: During interaction, protocol extracts ImportantFields and locks protocol_fields_hash + HMAC
lifecycle.wire: Parties submit karma1 AES-256-GCM ciphertext only (no plaintext on secure path)
lifecycle.anti_abuse: per-capture nonce replay rejection + attempt budget
lifecycle.on_chain: scopeHash / IntentPackage commit to fields_hash + capture_id
lifecycle.verify_rule: After delivery, evidence MUST cover required_proof_fields; acceptance checks ONLY locked acceptance_criteria

scene_groups.daily_commerce: High-frequency consumer: ride, hotel, food, flight
